entries.value: Pinch here to rotate the 3D model
Look around you! Explore the 3D model at life-size and wander through all its spaces
Hello and welcome! If this is your first time using virtual reality, don't worry: it's very easy. You can interact in two ways with the buttons you see only with your hands.
Touch Bring your finger close as if it were a real button.
Gesture Pinch with your thumb and index finger and point at the button.
Take your time to experiment and enjoy the experience.
Rotate your hand Look at the palm of your left hand for more help.
<color=#555555>Select a point of interest to view its description.</color>
